root_cause.text: `need_futex_hash_allocate_default()` incorrectly required the `CLONE_THREAD` flag in addition to `CLONE_VM` to allocate a default futex hash, failing to allocate it when an `mm` was shared without creating a thread, which led to a use-after-free in `futex_hash_put`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes `need_futex_hash_allocate_default()` to return true for any `CLONE_VM` clone except `CLONE_VFORK`, removing the requirement for `CLONE_THREAD`, while the commit message notes that abusing `CLONE_THREAD` "breaks the non-concurrency assumptions when doing the mm->futex_ref pcpu allocations, leading to... slab-use-after-free in futex_hash_put".

bic_trace_step.reason: The function `need_futex_hash_allocate_default` introduced in this commit requires both `CLONE_THREAD` and `CLONE_VM` to be set in `clone_flags` to return true, as seen in lines: `if ((clone_flags & (CLONE_THREAD | CLONE_VM)) != (CLONE_THREAD | CLONE_VM)) return false;`. This is the exact buggy condition described in the root cause, which fails to allocate the default futex hash when `CLONE_VM` is set without `CLONE_THREAD` (i.e., when an mm is shared without creating a thread).
